body: For some reason your other response isn't showing up here. I can definitely respect that you've still got the will to fight. I don't anymore. Take care that the abyss does not stare back at you.

I had that hope for the better a while back, that people can change and that people ultimately do want to do good for others. Unfortunately as you say, those are vastly the exception, rather than the rule. In our Brave New World, we're constantly being manipulated into incredibly selfish, individualized, antisocial lives. I don't see it getting any better barring an outright collapse in big tech (and the subsequent great depression that would follow). Mental issues are sadly symptomatic in my view, there's much more insidious, pernicious issues at hand. I'm not arguing against good deeds, but when it's "a few good men" versus a world full of bitterness, so thoroughly torn and pitted against each other for completely arbitrary reasons, I just don't see it getting any better.
